messages:
marta_sales: Quick sync  LargeFin wants confirmation: can our on-prem operator do rolling upgrades in an air-gapped install with zero-or-minimal downtime? They specifically asked about DB migrations and single-node restarts.

leo_se: short: yes, we support rolling upgrades but with constraints. operator coordinates upgrades but actual downtime depends on workload replica counts and how bundles are delivered (full vs delta). DB migrations that require schema locks may cause brief pauses unless you use online-migration tooling.

jin_eng: technical detail: operator is controller-based (leader election) and can issue per-pod image updates. For airgap we assume images are preloaded in a local registry (we support registry import CLI). Rolling update pattern we recommend: drain node -> ensure replica set healthy -> update daemon/statefulset -> uncordon. That yields node-by-node restarts.

ops_sam: customer also asked about upgrade cadence for POC: monthly security drops + ad-hoc hotfixes. Can we offer a 48h response SLA for emergency patches during the POC?

leo_se: we can include a temporary "POC hotfix add-on": 48h triage + bundle build + signed delta release. Pricing to be added to quote. Note: delta bundles reduce transfer size but rely on image layer consistency. If they prefer minibundles (full) it's simpler but bigger.

marta_sales: they care about signature provenance and key custody. What wording should I add to the security questionnaire?

jin_eng: answer to include: bundles are produced with detached signatures (notary v2 compatible). For POC we can sign with Redwood ephemeral key, but for production we recommend BYO key material via customer KMS/HSM. We provide verification commands to validate checksum + signature before import.

leo_se: add sample verification snippet to the SOW:

```
# on jumpbox after transfer
shasum -a 256 bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
cosign verify-blob --key <pubkey.pem> --signature bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz.sig bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
# import to local registry
ctr -n k8s.io images import bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
```

ops_sam: operational caveat: if their registry performs content-addressable rewriting (ID changes), delta bundles fail unless we include manifest mapping. We'll run a preflight tool to detect registry rewriting. That preflight takes ~15-30min in most environments.

marta_sales: customer asked for a one-paragraph SOW blurb about downtime expectations.

leo_se: SOW blurb (short): "Redwood's operator supports node-by-node rolling updates for air-gapped clusters when images are imported to a local registry. High availability requires replica counts >=2 for stateful services; certain schema-changing DB migrations may introduce brief transaction pauses and should be scheduled in maintenance windows. Redwood will provide monthly minibundles for the POC and an optional 48-hour emergency hotfix add-on."

jin_eng: addendum: recommend they provision a small staging cluster with same topology (same pod counts, same registry flow) for the POC so we can validate delta bundles and run the preflight.

marta_sales: next steps I'll send an email with: SOW blurb, pricing note for POC hotfix add-on, verification snippet, and request for jumpbox + registry access details or confirmation of BYO-key for signing.

deploy-bot: bundle 2026-03-01 created by @jin_eng (sha256:deadbeef...); verify artifacts uploaded to S3 (offline manifest attached).
